repo_meta_data.description: Media Gen MCP — Strict TypeScript MCP server for OpenAI gpt-image-1 and sora-2: generate, edit, and fetch images/video with smart compression, resource_link and image outputs, and a built-in test tool for MCP clients. Production-focused (full strict, zero any, lint), optional sharp processing.
